title: DartsDuel - Interactive darts game
author: MrSvenergy
selftext:
Hi everyone,

DartsDuel is a little game project I’ve been working on that I wanted to share with you. I started building it as a hobby back in 2024. Funny enough, the original idea actually came from a pretty weird dream I had about Yu-Gi-Oh and darts somehow being combined into one game.

At first, it was simply a chaotic party game concept for me and my friends to play with real cards. But over time I started thinking: “What if this could actually work online?”. That idea slowly evolved into DartsDuel.

DartsDuel combines reallife competitive darts with crazy effect cards that can completely change the flow of a match. Before you start your turn, simply draw a card. Some cards help you, others sabotage your opponent, and some create complete chaos during gameplay.

The game is turn based and currently includes:

\* Single Player: against a reallife friend, Solo (Training), or Vs Bot

\* Multi Player

\* Cards system (after drawing them ingame, it unlocks in your Cardbook)

\* Social system: profile/chat/badges and more

\* Three supported languages (🇬🇧 English, 🇳🇱 Dutch & 🇩🇪 German)

There are still lots of bugs and many things being improved, but the foundation is finally starting to come together. I would love to hear what people think. Please report any bugs, feature requests, or questions using the contact option on DartsDuel!

Thank you.

Link: \[https://dartsduelgame.com/\](https://dartsduelgame.com/)

\>\*\*Small disclaimer:\*\* The cards themselves are made with graphic designer (Tauron Design), who helped sketch the original card concepts and shape the visual style (so, no AI). Artwork inside the cards are AI-assisted because this started as a hobby project with limited resources, designing around 180 fully unique cards for a hobby/test project would otherwise be too costly and time-consuming for now. DartsDuel is completely free to play and will remain a non-profit project. I love the game of darts and the goal is simply to create a fun party-darts experience for myself and the community.

comments.body:
Sorry but myself and many others aren't going to play an AI generated game which starts by asking me to make an account and login.

If I was you, I'd get rid of that completely, and offer the option of creating an account to save progress or play multiplayer
